verses.original: כֹּ֥ה הִרְאַ֖נִי אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה כְּל֥וּב קָֽיִץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh hir·’a·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh kə·lūḇ qā·yiṣ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD showed me I saw a basket of summer fruit
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR DEUS assim me fez ver: E eis aqui um cesto de frutos do verão.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה־ אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר כְּל֣וּב קָ֑יִץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י בָּ֤א הַקֵּץ֙ אֶל־ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־ אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh ‘ā·mō·ws wā·’ō·mar kə·lūḇ qā·yiṣ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay bā haq·qêṣ ’el- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl lō- ’ō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ ‘ă·ḇō·wr lōw
verses.literal: Amos what do you see He asked A basket of summer fruit I replied So the LORD said to me The end has come for My people Israel I will no longer . . . spare them
verses.literalPt: E disse: Que vês, Amós? E eu disse: Um cesto de frutos do verão. Então o SENHOR me disse: Chegou o fim sobre o meu povo Israel; nunca mais passarei por ele.

verses.original: וְהֵילִ֜ילוּ שִׁיר֤וֹת הֵיכָל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רַ֣ב הַפֶּ֔גֶר בְּכָל־ מָק֖וֹם הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ הָֽס׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·lî·lū šî·rō·wṯ hê·ḵāl bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh raḇ hap·pe·ḡer bə·ḵāl mā·qō·wm hiš·lîḵ hās
verses.literal: In that day declares the Lord GOD the songs of the temple will turn to wailing Many will be the corpses strewn in silence everywhere . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas os cânticos do templo naquele dia serão gemidos, diz o Senhor DEUS; multiplicar-se-ão os cadáveres; em todos os lugares serão lançados fora em silêncio.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֕את הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֖ים אֶבְי֑וֹן וְלַשְׁבִּ֖ית עַנְוֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: Hear this you who trample the needy who do away with the poor of the land
verses.literalPt: Ouvi isto, vós que anelais o abatimento do necessitado; e destruís os miseráveis da terra,

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר מָתַ֞י יַעֲבֹ֤ר הַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְנַשְׁבִּ֣ירָה שֶּׁ֔בֶר וְהַשַּׁבָּ֖ת וְנִפְתְּחָה־ בָּ֑ר לְהַקְטִ֤ין אֵיפָה֙ וּלְהַגְדִּ֣יל שֶׁ֔קֶל וּלְעַוֵּ֖ת מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr mā·ṯay ya·‘ă·ḇōr ha·ḥō·ḏeš wə·naš·bî·rāh še·ḇer wə·haš·šab·bāṯ wə·nip̄·tə·ḥāh- bār lə·haq·ṭîn ’ê·p̄āh ū·lə·haḡ·dîl še·qel ū·lə·‘aw·wêṯ mō·zə·nê mir·māh
verses.literal: asking When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain When will the Sabbath end that we may market wheat Let us reduce the ephah and increase the shekel let us cheat with dishonest scales
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Quando passará a lua nova, para vendermos o grão, e o sábado, para abrirmos os celeiros de trigo, diminuindo o efa, e aumentando o siclo, e procedendo dolosamente com balanças enganosas,

verses.original: לִקְנ֤וֹת בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֣וּר נַעֲלָ֑יִם וּמַפַּ֥ל בַּ֖ר נַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: liq·nō·wṯ bak·ke·sep̄ dal·lîm wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ba·‘ă·ḇūr na·‘ă·lā·yim ū·map·pal bar naš·bîr
verses.literal: Let us buy the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals selling even the chaff with the wheat
verses.literalPt: Para comprarmos os pobres por dinheiro, e os necessitados por um par de sapatos, e para vendermos o refugo do trigo.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בִּגְא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֑ב אִם־ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶ֖צַח כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: niš·ba‘ Yah·weh biḡ·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’im- ’eš·kaḥ lā·ne·ṣaḥ kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·hem
verses.literal: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob I will never . . . forget any of their deeds
verses.literalPt: Jurou o SENHOR pela glória de Jacó: Eu não me esquecerei de todas as suas obras para sempre.

verses.original: הַ֤עַל זֹאת֙ לֹֽא־ תִרְגַּ֣ז הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָבַ֖ל כָּל־ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כָאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְנִגְרְשָׁ֥ה וְנִשְׁקָה כִּיא֥וֹר מִצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al zōṯ lō- ṯir·gaz hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ā·ḇal kāl- yō·wō·šêḇ bāh wə·‘ā·lə·ṯāh ḵā·’ōr kul·lāh wə·niḡ·rə·šāh wə·niš·qå̄h kî·’ō·wr miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Will not the land quake for this and all its dwellers mourn All of it will swell like the Nile it will surge and then subside like the Nile in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Por causa disto não extremecerá a terra, e não chorará todo aquele que nela habita? Certamente levantar-se-á toda ela como o grande rio, e será agitada, e baixará como o rio do Egito.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם וְהַחֲשַׁכְתִּ֥י לָאָ֖רֶץ בְּי֥וֹם אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî haš·še·meš baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim wə·ha·ḥă·šaḵ·tî lā·’ā·reṣ bə·yō·wm ’ō·wr
verses.literal: And in that day declares the Lord GOD I will make the sun go down at noon and I will darken the earth in the daytime . . .
verses.literalPt: E sucederá que, naquele dia, diz o Senhor DEUS, farei que o sol se ponha ao meio dia, e a terra se entenebreça no dia claro.

verses.original: וְהָפַכְתִּ֨י חַגֵּיכֶ֜ם לְאֵ֗בֶל וְכָל־ שִֽׁירֵיכֶם֙ לְקִינָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עַל־ כָּל־ מָתְנַ֙יִם֙ שָׂ֔ק וְעַל־ כָּל־ רֹ֖אשׁ קָרְחָ֑ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֙יהָ֙ כְּאֵ֣בֶל יָחִ֔יד וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ כְּי֥וֹם מָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·p̄aḵ·tî ḥag·gê·ḵem lə·’ê·ḇel wə·ḵāl šî·rê·ḵem lə·qî·nāh wə·ha·‘ă·lê·ṯî ‘al- kāl- mā·ṯə·na·yim śāq wə·‘al- kāl- rōš qā·rə·ḥāh wə·śam·tî·hā kə·’ê·ḇel yā·ḥîḏ wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh kə·yō·wm mār
verses.literal: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation I will cause everyone to wear . . . . . . sackcloth . . . and every head to be shaved I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son and its outcome like a bitter day
verses.literalPt: E tornarei as vossas festas em luto, e todos os vossos cânticos em lamentações; e porei pano de saco sobre todos os lombos, e calva sobre toda cabeça; e farei que isso seja como luto por um filho único, e o seu fim como dia de amarguras.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֗ים נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא־ רָעָ֤ב לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ וְלֹֽא־ צָמָ֣א לַמַּ֔יִם כִּ֣י אִם־ לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hiš·laḥ·tî rā·‘āḇ bā·’ā·reṣ lō- rā·‘āḇ lal·le·ḥem wə·lō- ṣā·mā lam·ma·yim kî ’im- liš·mō·a‘ ’êṯ diḇ·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the Lord GOD when I will send a famine on the land not a famine of bread . . . or a thirst for water but a famine . . . of hearing the words of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o Senhor DEUS, em que enviarei fome sobre a terra; não fome de pão, nem sede de água, mas de ouvir as palavras do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְנָעוּ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־ יָ֔ם וּמִצָּפ֖וֹן וְעַד־ מִזְרָ֑ח יְשֽׁוֹטְט֛וּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יִמְצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·‘ū mî·yām ‘aḏ- yām ū·miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·‘aḏ- miz·rāḥ yə·šō·wṭ·ṭū lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- də·ḇar- Yah·weh wə·lō yim·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east seeking the word of the LORD but they will not find it
verses.literalPt: E irão errantes de um mar até outro mar, e do norte até ao oriente; correrão por toda a parte, buscando a palavra do SENHOR, mas não a acharão.

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא תִּ֠תְעַלַּפְנָה הַבְּתוּלֹ֧ת הַיָּפ֛וֹת וְהַבַּחוּרִ֖ים בַּצָּמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū tiṯ·‘al·lap̄·nāh hab·bə·ṯū·lōṯ hay·yā·p̄ō·wṯ wə·hab·ba·ḥū·rîm baṣ·ṣā·mā
verses.literal: In that day the lovely young women the young men as well will faint from thirst
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia as virgens formosas e os jovens desmaiarão de sede.

verses.original: הַנִּשְׁבָּעִים֙ בְּאַשְׁמַ֣ת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְאָמְר֗וּ חֵ֤י אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ דָּ֔ן וְחֵ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ בְּאֵֽר־ שָׁ֑בַע וְנָפְל֖וּ וְלֹא־ יָק֥וּמוּ עֽוֹד׃ס
verses.transliteration: han·niš·bā·‘îm bə·’aš·maṯ šō·mə·rō·wn wə·’ā·mə·rū ḥê ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā dān wə·ḥê de·reḵ bə·’êr- šā·ḇa‘ wə·nā·p̄ə·lū wə·lō- yā·qū·mū ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say As surely as your god lives O Dan or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives they will fall never to rise again
verses.literalPt: Os que juram pela culpa de Samaria, dizendo: Vive o teu deus, ó Dã; e vive o caminho de Berseba; esses mesmos cairão, e não se levantarão jamais.
